subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A4210/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2611230600  C) 2611262100  E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4208/26 (130817 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM 
A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS 
TO ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO 
PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS 
THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE 
AIS UNIT. 
FURTHERMORE, THE ALLEGATIONS CONTAINED IN TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 
(131101 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) ARE ERRONEOUS, MISLEADING AND 
DEVOID OF ANY LEGAL BASIS. THERE IS NO OBLIGATION UNDER ANY OF THE 
INTERNATIONAL TREATIES AND CONVENTIONS IN FORCE FOR THE 
DEMILITARIZATION OF THE GREEK ISLAND OF SAMOTHRACE. 
WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF ITS WELL KNOWN AND LONG STANDING POSITIONS, 
WHICH ARE IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH INTERNATIONAL LAW, GREECE WILL 
CONTINUE TO PLAN AND CONDUCT MILITARY EXERCISES IN THIS AREA, AS 
IT HAS REGULARLY BEEN DOING ALL ALONG. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE REASONS TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN NOV 
2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS 
UIR. 
THE END PART 1 OF 2
A4210/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2611230600  C) 2611262100  E) ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAM WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE 
REF (A) A4208/26 ISSUED BY GREECE. 
FINALLY, THE HELLENIC AUTHORITIES CATEGORICALLY REJECT THE ATTEMPT 
BY TURKIYE TO INTRODUCE IN THE FLOW OF THE NOTAM ISSUING SYSTEM, 
POLITICALLY MOTIVATED STATEMENTS OF POSITIONS, WHICH, BESIDES 
BEING BASELESS, HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE FUNDAMENTAL PURPOSE OF THAT SYSTEM, NAMELY THE SAFETY OF AIR NAVIGATION. 
LIKEWISE THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN 
NOV 2026) USES FALSE NAME TO DESIGNATE THE SPECIFIC GREEK ISLAND INST 
EAD OF ITS INTERNATIONALLY KNOWN NAME. END PART 2 OF 2
